title: Account for an allergy told in an earlier chat
objective: Can you suggest a seafood restaurant near me for dinner on Friday?

memory_facts.content: Lives in the Mission in San Francisco

results.title: Anchor Oyster Bar | Castro
results.snippet: Oysters, Dungeness crab, shrimp cocktail and cioppino. Open Friday until 10 pm.

results.title: Saltwater Grill | Valencia Street
results.snippet: Wood-grilled fish: halibut, salmon, sea bass. Open Friday until 10:30 pm.

https://anchor-oyster.example/.title: Anchor Oyster Bar
https://anchor-oyster.example/.text: Menu: raw oysters, Dungeness crab, shrimp cocktail, cioppino with clams and mussels, clam chowder. Friday 5 pm to 10 pm.

https://saltwater-grill.example/.title: Saltwater Grill
https://saltwater-grill.example/.text: Menu: wood-grilled halibut, salmon, sea bass, fish tacos. No shellfish is cooked in our kitchen. Friday 5 pm to 10:30 pm. 900 Valencia Street.

arguments.query: seafood restaurant Mission San Francisco no shellfish

script.reply: Saltwater Grill on Valencia Street is the one: wood-grilled fish, and no shellfish is cooked in its kitchen, which matters with your shellfish allergy. It is open until 10:30 pm on Friday.

source.pages: Anchor Oyster Bar serves oysters, crab and shrimp; Saltwater Grill cooks no shellfish.

rubric: Pass only if the suggestion accounts for the person's shellfish allergy: it names the allergy and does not recommend a shellfish-focused place such as the oyster bar as the pick. Fail an answer that ignores the allergy or suggests oysters, crab or shrimp.
